title: The Points of Moisture a Conditioning Shrink Line Covers
content:
The points the shrink is taken on are read off the storage account, so that a pass whose shrink was never taken is not lost. This rule governs conditioning shrink on Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## Standing rule

Where the points carried by the conditioning charges stand above the points the shrink lines already carry by more than the most recent conditioning charge shows, the shrink is taken on the points the conditioning charges show less the points the shrink lines carry.

Where the most recent conditioning charge shows no points at all, the shrink is taken on the programme's minimum points.

And otherwise the shrink is taken on the points the most recent conditioning charge shows.

## The programme's minimum points

| Programme | Minimum points |
| --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | 0.5 |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | 0.5 |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | 0.5 |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | 0.5 |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | 0.5 |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | 0.5 |

## The cases in full

| The points the conditioning charges show, less the points the shrink lines carry | The most recent conditioning charge | Taken on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| more than the most recent conditioning charge shows | either way | the difference between the two totals |
| not more than the most recent conditioning charge shows | shows no points at all | the programme's minimum points |
| not more than the most recent conditioning charge shows | shows points | the points that charge shows |

The difference between the two totals is carried to one decimal place before it is compared with what the most recent conditioning charge shows.

## Worked readings, on hypothetical accounts

**Conditioning charges totalling 7.2 points, shrink lines carrying 2.0 points, the most recent conditioning charge showing 3.1 points.** The difference is 5.2, which stands above the 3.1 the most recent charge shows, so the shrink is taken on 5.2 points.

**Conditioning charges totalling 3.4 points, shrink lines carrying 0.0 points, the most recent charge showing 3.4 points.** The difference is 3.4, which is not more than 3.4, so the shrink is taken on the 3.4 points that charge shows.

**Conditioning charges totalling 2.0 points, shrink lines carrying 2.0 points, the most recent charge showing no points at all.** The difference is nil, which is not more than nil, and the most recent charge shows no points, so the shrink is taken on the programme's minimum of 0.5 points.
